To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the diagonal elements (E/B) of the window functions for C MB polarization power spectra are maximised for interferometers with linearly polarized receivers when the polarizers are rotated to certain angles with respect to the associated baselines, while for circularly polarized receivers they are maximized when the polarizers have no rotation.

the sensitivity to CMB B mode of interferometric measurement of the linear polarization is maximized in the case of a certain polarizer frame rotation, and the sensitivity to Cmb E/B power spectrum estimation is invariant under the polarizer rotation in the case that the polarizer is circular.
the diagonal elements in window function are maximized, and the 1σ error of B mode power spectrum estimation is minimized, when the polarizers are aligned with the associated baselines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the sensitivity of CMB B mode in interferometric measurement.
the optimization of the interferometer experiment for the measurement of CMB polarization.
the optimization of CMB E/B mode measurement with interferometers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the B mode measurement of interferometers with circular polarizers can be optimized, and the B mode measurement can be optimized by linear combination of interferometric visibilities of linear polarizer interferometers, while the E/B mixing can be minimized in interferometric measurement by linear polarizers.

the interferometric measurement of the linear polarization is the most efficient way to measure the B mode power spectrum, and the optimal polarizer orientation for B mode measurement is the one that is parallel with the associated baseline.
the B mode measurement in interferometers is optimized with circular polarizers, while the B mode measurement with linear polarizer is optimized with a rotation of polarizer frame.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the sensitivity of interferometers to CMB E andB mode can be maximized by aligning the polarizer frame in certain rotation from associated baselines.
the sensitivity and the E/B mixing of interferometric measurement of CMB B mode are maximized when the polarizer frames are rotated to certain angles from the associated baselines.
the sensitivity of interferometer with linear polarizers for CMB B modes are maximized when the polarizers are in certain optimal rotation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
interferometers with circular polarizers can be optimized for CMB E and/or B mode measurement.
the interferometer with circular or linear polarizers can optimize the B mode measurement by aligning the polarizer frame to the associated baselines.
the interferometer measurement with circular polarizer is optimal for B mode detection.
